d: I made iron using the old blower variant but using a larger diameter fan (30 cm rather than 25 cm). I did a longer smelt and a shorter smelt. The long smelt made 10 g of iron but the short smelt made 14 g sugesting that multiple shorter duration smelts may be more effective at producing iron rather than one long smelt. The iron was then put into a knife shaped mold and placed in a forge under a flattened tuyere to spread the blast ino a sheet.
